Privacy policy

Last updated 10 November 2026

The toolkit doesn’t ask you to sign up, and the team behind it doesn’t collect, store or sell your answers.

Your answers and your plan

Your answers, project title, shortlist and Database filters stay in your browser. They’re kept in the page address (the part after the #), so you can bookmark or copy the link to come back to them. Anyone you share that link with can see what’s in it. The toolkit never sends your answers to us or to anyone else.

Downloads and copies

PDFs and Markdown copies of your plan or your Database search are made in your browser and saved to your device. Nothing is uploaded.

Email links

“Send via email”, “Report an error” and “Contact us” open your own email app with a draft message. Nothing is sent unless you send it yourself.

Cookies and storage

The toolkit uses no cookies, analytics or advertising trackers. It remembers two display settings (the page background and frame) in your browser’s local storage, and nothing else.

Other services

To show the page, your browser loads fonts from Google Fonts and the PDF tool from cdnjs (Cloudflare). Like any website request, these services receive your IP address and browser details, under their own privacy policies. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may keep standard visit logs. Links to venues, festivals and case studies take you to other websites, which have their own policies.

Venue information

Venue and festival details come from public sources and the toolkit’s research database. If you represent a venue and want its details corrected or removed, use “Report an error”.
